items.quote: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, LORD, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people?
items.claim: Moses reports that the LORD has treated the people evil

items.quote: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people
items.claim: Pharaoh did evil to the people after Moses came to speak in the LORD's name

items.quote: neither hast thou delivered thy people at all
items.claim: The LORD has not delivered the people
